note: Each requirement a test proves, registered before its test exists. A row holds its id (<owner's last segment>.<words>), one description sentence, the owner package, its layer (unit, integration, contract, e2e or native; a layer's limit is test-sizes.json's for its size) and its seconds budget; a test names the ids it proves with @pytest.mark.proves. Holders, lifecycle (proposed, active, quarantined, retired) and the commit that added a row are derived, never stored. An id is never reused: a retired row stays. Find before writing one: python scripts/tests_registry.py find "<words>".

alpha_research.current_artifacts_full_pr.description: If full proof passed an Alpha artifact changed under its name, an export or the scrub would carry bytes its commitment no longer names.
alpha_research.current_artifacts_full_pr.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.current_artifacts_read_on.description: If a sealed Alpha observation or feature artifact were read and decoded again for each request, every daily read would pay work its sealed name already settled.
alpha_research.current_artifacts_read_on.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_full_pro.description: If full proof passed lifecycle arrays changed under their name, an install, an activation or the scrub would admit bytes never proved.
alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_full_pro.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_kept_per.description: If sealed lifecycle arrays were read and decoded again for each admission, every daily score would repeat work their sealed name already settled.
alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_kept_per.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.sealed_selection_survives.description: If members added later could move a sealed inner selection, an Alpha study's recorded choice would stop matching the evidence it came from.

alpha_research.verification_hash_covers_.description: If an executed scoring or outcome module sat outside the verified hash, changed code would keep an old identity and pass as already verified.

alternative_evidence.absent_consent_uses.description: An absent Evidence source consent reads as the default while an unreadable record does not.

alternative_evidence.historical_identity.description: Observed Evidence history excludes current and supported bindings while retaining each unknown tuple once.

alternative_evidence.host_stop_preserves.description: A Host stop during a coverage unit leaves no sealed unit failure and the same Task resumes after the Host restarts.

alternative_evidence.int8_generation_nam.description: If an int8 generation did not name its machine class in its identity, or another generation's hash moved, numbers from different machines could be compared by bytes.

alternative_evidence.review_rerun_joins_.description: A repeated book review joins the preparation in flight at any cutoff, reads no filing index beside it, and a parked one is handed back without a person.

alternative_evidence.review_stands_on_it.description: A later run of the same positions that no analysis answers does not take a book's review from the run its analyses answer, and a run that carried them keeps it.

alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_bi.description: If the Evidence runtime's identity left out an owner of selection or a capability, reviews could reuse retrieval from a different runtime.

alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_re.description: If a workspace installed an Evidence runtime whose semantic capability differs, its reviews would run on a model its identity never named.

architecture.an_unlisted_persisting_writ.description: A writer that persists bytes and no data family lists is refused by name at commit, while a read and an in-memory database are not.
architecture.an_unlisted_persisting_writ.lower_layer: The scan reads a planted module file through the cached per-file facts store, which a unit test cannot reach.

architecture.an_unresolved_change_stops_.description: A change no consumer map resolves stops the verification runner at its exit code; it never plans nothing and passes.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

architecture.discovered_imports_kept_by_.description: A module's discovered imports are kept in the process by its place under the source root and its bytes, so changed bytes or another place miss and a read or parse error is raised every time.

architecture.every_persisted_family_is_l.description: Every writer the product persists through is listed by a data family, and every storage and artifact authority group is covered by exactly one.
architecture.every_persisted_family_is_l.lower_layer: It reads the whole source tree and three registries from disk.

architecture.every_src_module_imports_of.description: Every src module imports with the network disabled, and each pydantic contract's frozen and extra settings at runtime match those read from source by the static contract test.

architecture.impact_graph_selection.description: The verification selector finds real consumer and deleted-source tests and dispatches them without repeating structural checks.

architecture.import_law_refuses_higher_l.description: The import law built from the package registry refuses a package importing a higher level or an undeclared peer, and any file importing a retired owner, direct or relative; an import downward or of a lookalike name passes.

architecture.repository_root_is_its_trac.description: The repository root is judged by the files git tracks at HEAD: its required public files, nothing unexpected, and never a checkout's ignored or untracked local files.

architecture.scan_facts_kept_by_bytes_un.description: A scan's kept per-file fact is served only for the bytes it came from under a valid seal and shape, and its store stays bounded and rebuildable.

architecture.type_ignores_only_fall.description: A commit is refused when a file's type: ignore count for an error code rises, a new file holds one, one names no code, or the baseline rose; one command lowers it.
architecture.type_ignores_only_fall.lower_layer: The refusal reads staged blobs, a staged move and the parent's baseline through Git, which a unit test cannot hold.

exception.why: The finder was reached only through its script, so the module-proof guard was red on develop; a direct case of the deciding function repairs it
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: the maintainer: fold the develop red's repair into the card it blocked, one direct case, no allowance raised

architecture.wait_baseline_only_falls.description: A commit is refused when a staged source holds more wait findings than the baseline, or when the baseline rose above its parent.
architecture.wait_baseline_only_falls.lower_layer: The refusal reads staged blobs and the parent's baseline through Git, which a unit test cannot hold.

architecture.wait_rules_refuse_each_anti.description: Each wait rule refuses its unbounded wait or loop by name with its repair, and passes that repair and the wait primitive itself.

composition.achieved_goal_has_a_delivera.description: An achieved Goal must deliver a verified reference even when the original declaration named no deliverable slot.

composition.cli_names_a_closed_output_pi.description: The command reports an output pipe that closes before its answer finishes and returns failure.

composition.goal_export_proves_its_sourc.description: If a Goal export answered from kept sources, a changed sealed result could leave the workspace without a fresh proof.
composition.goal_export_proves_its_sourc.lower_layer: It composes a Goal over a real Host reading a sealed result through the reader the Goal application calls.

composition.keyed_analyst_submissions_ke.description: Concurrent keyed Analyst submissions receive definite outcomes, filed outcomes replay exactly, and refusals that filed nothing are retryable.

composition.observation_writes_do_not_wa.description: A held workspace mutation does not prevent the independent observation owner from recording request entry and a counted refusal.

composition.only_a_finished_first_use_ow.description: A network cleanup belongs only to a finished first-use Goal and follows its last delegated network choice.
composition.only_a_finished_first_use_ow.lower_layer: The Goal composition owner imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

composition.replay_refuses_a_tampered_in.description: If a replay ran from a tampered input bundle, it would claim to reproduce a result from bytes that were never bound.
composition.replay_refuses_a_tampered_in.lower_layer: It tampers a bound input copy and replays through a real Host and its worker.

composition.scrub_finds_a_changed_study_.description: If a sealed file changed under its name went unnoticed, an export would leave with changed bytes; the scrub must find it and the study must refuse until its bytes check again.
composition.scrub_finds_a_changed_study_.lower_layer: It plants a change in a published study's evidence and drives reads, an export and the scrub through a real Host.

composition.sealed_review_update_verifie.description: Concurrent readers of one sealed review update share one verification, each with its own copy, and a failed verification is never kept.

composition.session_observation_attribut.description: A named sandbox-bound Session keeps its request attribution while an anonymous request remains unassigned and Activity names that attribution unknown.

composition.unstarted_evidence_task_repo.description: An Evidence Task without a run reports the cutoff from its sealed request.
composition.unstarted_evidence_task_repo.lower_layer: The Evidence composition owner imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

composition.workspace_binding_usage_unkn.description: An unreadable workspace-owned Session binding makes usage unavailable without hiding other readable Session results or treating the binding as absent.

data_layer.a_clients_trace_reaches_its_w.description: A client request carrying W3C trace context is one Host step in that trace, and its worker call is the step's child span, attributed by baggage, read back from the log.
data_layer.a_clients_trace_reaches_its_w.lower_layer: A real Host serves the request over loopback HTTP and a real worker process runs the call; the spans are read from a real log.

data_layer.a_rename_moves_no_key.description: A renamed method, metric or feature set keeps its lineage's id, so no recipe key, measure, cache entry or derived partition moves, and every old name still finds it.
data_layer.a_rename_moves_no_key.lower_layer: A rename is an event projected inside the log's own SQLite transaction; only a real log shows the rows it leaves.

data_layer.admission_is_read_as_of_befor.description: One admission's rows share one known_at that never steps back with the wall clock; the as-of read before its correction sees them, after it sees the correction, and the replaced version is superseded in the same commit.
data_layer.admission_is_read_as_of_befor.lower_layer: The as-of read is DuckDB's macro over a real DuckLake catalog.

data_layer.append_admits_only_a_keepable.description: The append boundary refuses by name a missing attribute, an unbound, missing or unexpected text, a malformed count or part, a credential and a live write under a superseded definition.

data_layer.backup_copies_only_new_files.description: A machine backup copies newly referenced immutable files into its shared pool, reuses unchanged held files and refuses a changed sealed name or a path outside its roots.

data_layer.backup_manifest_is_portable.description: A machine backup manifest names exactly its three databases, a well-formed chain head and unique relative data/blob handles; malformed or escaping handles are refused before restore writes.

data_layer.baggage_attributes_every_span.description: A span started below W3C headers is their trace's child and carries the trial and selection its baggage names and the workspace its caller binds, whatever workspace the baggage claims.

data_layer.chain_catches_a_rewritten_eve.description: The chain verifies whole and from its last checkpoint, a new log is seeded and checkpointed monthly, and an event rewritten past its trigger breaks the fold.
data_layer.chain_catches_a_rewritten_eve.lower_layer: The chain folds rows of a real SQLite log, rewritten past its trigger.

data_layer.data_root_is_set_or_the_appli.description: The data root is ALPHALATTICE_DATA_ROOT when set, else the platform's application data folder.

data_layer.durable_events_commit_at_once.description: A durable event commits when appended; an ordinary one with its batch, its deadline, or the flush a reply waits for, which a Host killed after the reply keeps.
data_layer.durable_events_commit_at_once.lower_layer: Commit visibility is what another SQLite connection reads, and a kill is a real process's death.

data_layer.event_ids_are_uuidv7.description: A new event's id is a UUIDv7 whose leading 48 bits are the Unix milliseconds it was minted in.

data_layer.experience_reads_without_bodi.description: The reading views and compare read profiles and measures only: with every artifact body removed, experience returns each trial with its measures and two artifacts compare across a convertible metric version.
data_layer.experience_reads_without_bodi.lower_layer: The views are DuckDB SQL over the attached SQLite log; only both engines run them.

data_layer.heavy_work_runs_beside_the_wr.description: An append and its flush made while a large admission is digested and staged wait as an ordinary one does, since staging runs in the process that has the rows and never under the writer.
data_layer.heavy_work_runs_beside_the_wr.lower_layer: The wait is measured on a real log's commits against a second real process.

data_layer.held_files_wait_in_the_deleti.description: A file another handle holds open waits in the deletion queue with its error and tries, and goes at the first start after it is released.
data_layer.held_files_wait_in_the_deleti.lower_layer: Windows' refusal to delete an open file is the operating system's, on a real disk.

data_layer.host_append_is_all_or_nothing.description: Each append writes the event, its text, the chain head, its projection and an inline body as one unit: a refused event leaves no trace and its batch's other events whole.
data_layer.host_append_is_all_or_nothing.lower_layer: The unit is a SQLite transaction and its savepoints; only a real database holds them.

data_layer.host_history_records_or_defer.description: A Host's history records its workspace and the Host's own definitions, and records nothing while another Host holds the data root.
data_layer.host_history_records_or_defer.lower_layer: The lock is an operating-system file lock and the history a real SQLite log.

data_layer.kill_inside_append_leaves_the.description: A process killed after an event's row, after its chain fold or after its projection leaves a log the next Host opens whole, with the chain verifying.
data_layer.kill_inside_append_leaves_the.lower_layer: A kill is a real process ending inside a SQLite transaction.

data_layer.legacy_rows_are_known_from_th.description: StorePort admits every catalog table; a legacy row's known_at is empty and its known_asof its lag rule's lag after its market's next session close; typed columns, 0.2.7's outcome types included, read back as admitted.
data_layer.legacy_rows_are_known_from_th.lower_layer: The lag rule is read from a real log's definition and the session close from a real DuckLake catalog.

data_layer.lineage_id_is_its_first_regis.description: A definition lineage's id is a digest of its family and the name it was first registered under, never a name.

data_layer.live_ref_bodies_are_never_col.description: A blob whose artifact a live reference holds is refused deletion by name and stays, while an unheld blob is deleted.
data_layer.live_ref_bodies_are_never_col.lower_layer: The hold is a live_ref row in a real SQLite log.

data_layer.log_refuses_what_its_rules_fo.description: Each rule of the data root's event log refuses its breach by name and leaves the log unchanged.
data_layer.log_refuses_what_its_rules_fo.lower_layer: The rules are SQLite triggers and constraints of log.sql; only a real database holds them.

data_layer.log_views_read_as_defined.description: Each view of the data root's event log reads a settled log as defined, and each hot read uses its index.
data_layer.log_views_read_as_defined.lower_layer: The views and query plans are SQLite's; only a real database holds them.

data_layer.machine_backup_keeps_a_repair.description: A backup captures index before log before catalog during a write burst without holding the Host for the backup; its log names no missing catalog snapshot and restore uses the existing owed-event repair.
data_layer.machine_backup_keeps_a_repair.lower_layer: The interleaving crosses real SQLite backup steps and a committed DuckLake snapshot with the Host writer active.

data_layer.machine_backup_restores_all_r.description: Online snapshots of all three machine databases and the admitted file set restore every retained result ALL EQUAL into a fresh root while workspace backup remains unchanged.
data_layer.machine_backup_restores_all_r.lower_layer: SQLite online backup, SQLite vectors and the DuckLake catalog/file readback require real databases and files.

data_layer.machine_restore_refuses_a_cha.description: Machine restore refuses a changed chain, changed retained bytes or a manifest missing an owned file before publishing the destination.
data_layer.machine_restore_refuses_a_cha.lower_layer: The corruption crosses real copied SQLite/DuckLake owners, retained files and the restore publication boundary.

data_layer.one_host_writes_the_data_root.description: A second Host is refused the data root's lock by name with its holder, and other processes read the log through a read-only attach that refuses a write.
data_layer.one_host_writes_the_data_root.lower_layer: The lock is an operating-system file lock and the attach a SQLite connection.

data_layer.paths_are_quoted_sql_literals.description: A data root path enters DuckDB SQL as a string literal with forward slashes and each quote doubled, so a folder named with a quote attaches.

data_layer.recipe_key_is_its_content.description: A recipe's key is the digest of its method's lineage, version, parameters and upstream recipes, whatever order they are written in, and never a name.

data_layer.repair_appends_each_owed_even.description: Repair appends each event a catalog snapshot carried and the log lacks once, with its writer's envelope and snapshot, at the next start even below the free-space floor that refuses staging.
data_layer.repair_appends_each_owed_even.lower_layer: The owed event is read from a real DuckLake snapshot's commit info and appended through the Host's write path into a real log.

data_layer.replay_rebuilds_every_project.description: A history replayed into an empty log rebuilds every projected table and the chain head ALL EQUAL, and a projection reading anything but its event is named by its table.
data_layer.replay_rebuilds_every_project.lower_layer: A projection is SQL inside the event's own SQLite transaction; only a real database replays it.

data_layer.root_created_twice_is_all_equ.description: Creating a data root with installed data dependencies creates the SQLite DuckLake catalog and runs its views and macros offline; repeating creation leaves every file byte-identical, and another schema version is refused by name.
data_layer.root_created_twice_is_all_equ.lower_layer: Creation writes SQLite databases and folders on disk.

data_layer.seed_registry_is_whole.description: The seed registry names each reference definition once as a registered family's version 1, with registry.seeded, the research tags and every artifact type's measures.
data_layer.seed_registry_is_whole.lower_layer: The seed registry is package data the unit layer may not read; the log a data root is born with holds it.

data_layer.spans_are_step_events.description: Each span ended through the OpenTelemetry SDK is appended as its step event with its trace, parent, times, phase, actor and attributes, and a span the log refuses is counted by its code, never raised.
data_layer.spans_are_step_events.lower_layer: The exporter writes into a real Host log through the SDK's span processor.

data_layer.stage_refuses_what_it_cannot_.description: Staging refuses by name two versions of one key in one admission, a table StorePort does not admit and a legacy batch with no valid date, before anything is staged.

data_layer.staging_keeps_every_rows_colu.description: Staging writes every column any row of an admission carries, not only the first row's, so a field a later row gives is kept.

data_layer.start_collects_what_no_write_.description: Start collects staging no producer holds and data files the catalog does not name, holding each admission's lock while it does, so a producer's staging is never lost.
data_layer.start_collects_what_no_write_.lower_layer: Collection reads a real DuckLake catalog's file tables and deletes files on disk.

data_layer.store_deletes_only_its_own_fi.description: StorePort refuses by name to delete anything outside the data root's staging, data and blobs folders, before touching the disk.

data_layer.upgrade_stops_before_unverifi.description: An upgrade does no work without verified backups and switches only an ALL EQUAL family; completed steps are not repeated.

data_layer.upgrade_verifies_before_switc.description: First 0.2.8 startup requires verified machine and workspace backups, resumes the first unfinished family after a kill, switches only verified ALL EQUAL families and serves no failed upgrade.
data_layer.upgrade_verifies_before_switc.lower_layer: The runner records durable progress in a real Host log and a killed child must resume with the old reader retained until verification.

data_layer.vector_table_defers_without_e.description: Without extension loading a data root still creates every index table but the vector table, and names that table deferred.
data_layer.vector_table_defers_without_e.lower_layer: The index is a SQLite database on disk, built through the extension loader.

data_layer.write_order_recovers_from_a_k.description: A Host killed after an observed, legacy or results admission's files, catalog commit or event leaves no half snapshot: the next start finds all its rows or none, its event once, and no staging.
data_layer.write_order_recovers_from_a_k.lower_layer: A kill is a real process's death between a real DuckLake commit and a real log append.

data_platform.session_authority_is_conte.description: The Host resolves one trading calendar: weekends are covered but are not sessions, and one range always seals the same axis while a narrower range seals another.

evaluation.continuation_snapshot_integri.description: A native acceptance continuation admits only the exact tracked bytes written by its recorded prestart configure and refuses other tracked changes.

evaluation.golden_consumers_queue_behind.description: Under a parallel run, a session golden's first consumer keeps its place and builds it, and its other consumers are queued where the recorded work ahead passes that build, or last when it is unrecorded, never blocked on its lock.

evaluation.listener_boundary_samples_sur.description: A replay monitor samples the local Host at both declared ACK markers before acknowledging them, including when work ends before the next periodic sample.

exception.why: A real Host exercises the sampled ACK markers
exception.decided: 2026-10-29: approved; real Host sampling exercises the ACK markers

evaluation.live_read_watches_every_task.description: A native run's live read keeps every Task it has seen current past the Host's per-page watch cap, so a leg sees its goal end.
evaluation.live_read_watches_every_task.lower_layer: The live reader joins paginated Host activity with task state and its persisted cursor, which an isolated decision cannot prove.

evaluation.native_first_use_keeps_the_ho.description: Native first use starts the Claude host with its session persistence and the ordinary agent's shipped tools and guidance, and offers PowerShell only on Windows.
evaluation.native_first_use_keeps_the_ho.lower_layer: The host argv builder lives in the intent provider, which imports subprocess, and the unit layer refuses a module that imports subprocess.

evaluation.native_gate_verdicts_follow_t.description: Each native release gate's verdict comes from one leg's own graded results, and a result the leg did not grade is a failed gate.

evaluation.native_hosts_stop_with_their_.description: A native acceptance run stops its own recorded workspace Hosts and proves each listener and process ended, or names the unproved stop.

evaluation.native_leg_stop_owns_process_.description: A requested native leg stop ends only its recorded driver and descendants, completes its own teardown and records any unproved cleanup.

evaluation.native_leg_stops_by_name.description: One command starts, resumes and collects a native leg of either host, and every stop carries a named reason and its evidence.

evaluation.native_snapshot_tolerates_pro.description: A native activity snapshot continues when an observed process exits or becomes inaccessible before sampling, preserving other observed processes.

evaluation.native_turn_cleanup_wait_is_f.description: A native turn refuses a zero, infinite or undefined cleanup wait by name before it starts a process or writes a receipt.
evaluation.native_turn_cleanup_wait_is_f.lower_layer: The native turn monitor imports subprocess and psutil, and the unit layer refuses a module that imports subprocess.

evaluation.one_leg_serves_every_native_g.description: A finished native leg runs the upgrade axis over its own recorded grades without changing its state, takes the scenario's settled date, and names a scenario person's stop.
evaluation.one_leg_serves_every_native_g.lower_layer: The native leg's driver and the upgrade entry import process facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

evaluation.persistent_golden_root_follow.description: The persistent golden cache root is the operator's shared setting when present and the checkout's own folder when absent.

evaluation.person_ask_posts_each_questio.description: The scenario person's ASK posts each question as one bounded process with its record and question filled in, and records the exit and words, or the start failure, beside the record; no ASK command posts nothing.
evaluation.person_ask_posts_each_questio.lower_layer: The poster's whole job is starting one bounded process and recording its exit, and the unit layer refuses a module that imports subprocess.

evaluation.release_gates_run_as_one_insp.description: The native release gates run as one Inspect AI task over each host's one prepared leg, with every gate's verdict and the scenario person's questions in its log.
evaluation.release_gates_run_as_one_insp.lower_layer: The task runs Inspect AI's evaluation loop and a leg process, which the unit layer cannot load.

evaluation.scenario_person_answers_and_g.description: The scenario person answers from the script, the fact sheet or a bounded ask, says it does not know past the bound, stops by name only on a Host question not named nonblocking, and records every question when asked.

evaluation.sessionless_first_use_questio.description: A sessionless first-use question is attributed only when its authenticated Host record matches the sole verified workspace and goal identity.

factor_research.curation_and_handoff_are.description: If Factor curation or Alpha handoff trained a model or depended on its actor, a recorded decision would not reopen safely.

feature_engine.closure_history_folds_its.description: If the closure ledger rebuilt a history from anything but its map and revisions, a Feature panel would mix sector facts from another time.

feature_engine.closure_ledger_survives_a.description: If the closure ledger lost its place across a failed store write or misread its revisions, Feature panels would rebuild wrongly or recompute published work.

feature_engine.closure_pointer_requires_.description: Feature closure pointers reject a partial or noncanonical content identity before looking up a head.

feature_engine.closure_store_takes_only_.description: If the coordinator handed the store identities it never derived, a Feature store could hold its data under another closure's name.

feature_engine.current_pointer_swaps_fai.description: If the current panel pointer moved without its compare and swap, two writers could leave readers on a publication neither finished.

feature_engine.factor_handoff_refuses_a_.description: If a Factor handoff accepted a corrupt copy, a changed source or a tampered pool, Alpha research would train on inputs its binding never named.

feature_engine.handoff_binds_logical_clo.description: If an Alpha handoff changed its original Factor inputs or failed to bind the logical panel closure, a later reader could use a different dataset.

feature_engine.logical_identity_moves_on.description: If logical identity followed encoding, write batches or policy instead of content, reuse would serve changed values or rebuild unchanged panels.

feature_engine.materialized_source_ident.description: A materialized source identity distinguishes missing observations from numerical zero at each session.

feature_engine.panel_chunks_stay_bound_t.description: If a panel chunk's bytes or hash drifted from the binding that wrote it, a reader would accept data under an identity it never had.

feature_engine.source_prefix_proof_tells.description: If materialization identity blurred null, NaN, signed zero or absent rows, or kept a sealed year after a write, stale Feature stores would pass as current.

knowledge.a_new_authority_takes_the_int8.description: If a new Evidence authority did not take the int8 recipe, or an installed one lost its own recipe on a rebind, first use stays slow or old indexes stop matching.

knowledge.int8_canary_is_proved_live_at_.description: If an int8 session loaded at the CPU budget's threads without equalling the canary one thread gives on this machine, threads could move retrieval numbers unseen.

knowledge.int8_recipe_is_the_retained_mo.description: If the int8 recipe named other models, shared a sealed canary, installed over the fp32 packs or shared identities across machine classes, results from different machines would mix.

local_application.a_disconnected_waiter_.description: When a Host stays unavailable through the wait cap the answer reports that the Task continues.
local_application.a_disconnected_waiter_.lower_layer: The real local client imports process and Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

local_application.codex_first_use_names_.description: Codex's trust of a project is read as Codex documents it: an untrusted project gets the person's one step, an explicitly untrusted one names their setting, and a trusted one is ready.

local_application.configure_offers_a_wor.description: A sandboxed configure offers the default new workspace when none exists and a coded choice when existing workspaces need selection.

local_application.configure_offers_missi.description: Sandboxed configure offers each missing setup prerequisite in order before its serve command.

local_application.doctor_names_windows_l.description: The doctor and no-Host refusal identify authenticated project Hosts; the Windows doctor reports long-path support and a packaged shell's potentially redirected model store.

local_application.first_use_offers_deleg.description: A first-use plan offers its delegated network action immediately without waiting for the separate coded daily-consent answer.

local_application.first_use_question_onl.description: An exact first-use Goal retry asks the daily question while unanswered and stops offering it after the person answers.

local_application.goal_revisions_enter_t.description: A new goal is recorded once, a conclusion is drawn, and the person's supporting or rejecting response to one is feedback.

local_application.native_tool_setup_uses.description: The offered locked tool setup runs its existing steps with checkout-owned Windows scratch and removes the scratch on success or failure.

local_application.node_invocation_preser.description: Node test invocation preserves availability and caller environment while resolving absolute browser directory aliases to their physical targets.

local_application.only_reconnects_named_.description: A waiter propagates an unrelated client refusal instead of treating it as a restart.
local_application.only_reconnects_named_.lower_layer: The real local client imports process and Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

local_application.playwright_setup_refus.description: Playwright setup refuses linked or unverifiable installation paths before mutating them while preserving independently owned physical installations.

local_application.research_runs_are_reco.description: A sealed research run is a trial with its selection, recipe and evidence artifact, a rerun is another trial, and the history replays ALL EQUAL.
local_application.research_runs_are_reco.lower_layer: The run is the real workflow over a real workspace, and the history a real SQLite log.

local_application.retrieval_setup_uses_w.description: Retrieval setup gives its Windows subprocesses a temporary directory inside the writable checkout and removes it after use.

market_data_ops.daily_provider_conforman.description: Every daily market-data provider, the yfinance adapter and each shared fake, answers bars, actions and adjusted closes in the port's shape: exactly the requested symbols, every field finite, inside the window, ascending and split-sound.

market_data_ops.hydration_provider_confo.description: Every one-response history provider returns the daily port's own rows with in-window actions, adjusted closes and repaired sessions that name only those rows.

market_data_ops.sector_provider_conforma.description: Every current-sector provider names itself and the symbol asked, gives a stripped sector and a 64-hex payload hash, answers alike twice, and refuses an unknown symbol with a typed provider failure.

market_data_ops.set_quality_inputs_match.description: Set-scoped quality inputs match the persisted admissions, closes and actions returned by each listing reader.
market_data_ops.set_quality_inputs_match.lower_layer: A real DuckDB store and Arrow result are needed to compare the persisted set query with its per-listing readers.

observation_runtime.accepted_answers_ent.description: If one accepted role answer published twice or lost its submitting lead, the ledger would count work that was never one exchange.

observation_runtime.ledger_has_one_sqlit.description: If two writers shared the store or a reader blocked the writer, ledger rows could interleave or the Host would stall recording.

observation_runtime.ledger_reads_answer_.description: If a bounded or correlated read followed a wrong run or hid a tampered row, callers would credit evidence the ledger does not hold.

observation_runtime.ledger_records_each_.description: If a repeated, corrected or failed append changed the observation ledger, its record of what happened could no longer be replayed or trusted.

observation_runtime.ledger_refuses_what_.description: If secrets, private cognition or unbacked decisions reached an append, the ledger would keep them durably or claim authority nobody gave.

observation_runtime.ledger_stays_inside_.description: If retention ignored the workspace cap or compacted protected rows partially, the ledger would fill the disk or silently lose records it promised to keep.

observation_runtime.process_is_held_to_h.description: A runner binds its process to at most half the machine's logical processors, or to the narrower allowance it already inherited, and reads the bound back from the operating system.

observation_runtime.usage_recording_expo.description: If a usage callback's failure or free text reached owner health, recording could break or private native paths and prose could leak to readers.

pipeline.a_boundary_import_is_refused_at.description: If the merge gate missed a changed import across the release boundary, a public file would ship depending on private code.

pipeline.a_change_that_would_conflict_wi.description: If a change that conflicts with develop passed the commit, the merge queue would refuse it only after review; the commit refuses it at once by name, as the harness's commit does with main.
pipeline.a_change_that_would_conflict_wi.lower_layer: The check asks Git to merge a staged tree into a real develop branch, so only a real repository can show the conflict it refuses.

pipeline.a_gate_tool_off_its_lock_is_ref.description: If a gate tool's installed version differed from uv.lock, an older Ruff would pass a commit without the rules it lacks, with no word of why.

pipeline.a_row_skipped_for_documents_nam.description: A provider may record a row as skipped for a change of documents only by naming those documents, and such a row classes no red.

pipeline.code_health_reports_every_row.description: The daily code-health report reads sizes, boundaries, growers, dead code, dependencies and complexity from the tree, reuses an unchanged tree's rows, and reads a failed row as unmeasured, never zero.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

pipeline.cost_receipt_contains_required_.description: A cost commit stage runs required Small and Medium test families and records their bounded outcomes; slow tests run separately.

pipeline.definition_refuses_malformed_ro.description: A malformed pipeline definition is refused on load by code, naming its stage or row, and the shipped definition loads.

pipeline.development_labels_cannot_grow_.description: If the development-label allowance could grow or reset, internal card and line names would leak into public files with nothing refusing them.

pipeline.every_child_check_names_its_fin.description: Each child check the fast guard runs prints its findings in the guard's own log, under its name and verdict, whether that log is a console, a pipe or a file.
pipeline.every_child_check_names_its_fin.lower_layer: The loss is a process boundary: only a real child process whose parent writes to a pipe or a file can show its words reaching that log.

pipeline.flake_quarantine_candidates.description: The test-health owner derives quarantine candidates from distinct verified flake observations, registered owners and review dates.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

pipeline.health_report_counts_the_test_m.description: The daily test-health report counts test and source lines, registered and multiply held requirements, large files, quarantines, stage verdicts, flakes and slow tests, ranks each test's seconds from healthy runs only, and leaves a rate unknown without receipts.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

pipeline.public_closure_needs_every_file.description: If a public file could import, link, run or read a private file, the published checkout would break for its users or point at private work.

pipeline.public_durations_come_from_juni.description: The public tests' durations file comes from JUnit records: the latest run of each node wins, skipped and out-of-tree nodes are left out, and an unreadable record refuses by name.

pipeline.public_manifest_settles_every_f.description: If the manifest guessed, skipped a file or let a public consumer pull private tools out, private work would escape in the next export.

pipeline.public_outputs_need_a_declared_.description: If a generated output counted as public without its declaration, write and proved sources, a private path or stale file could ship in the export.

pipeline.public_review_never_copies_a_di.description: If the manifest copied a disclosure's text or kept a review after its line changed, a secret could enter Git or an unreviewed edit could ship.

pipeline.public_snapshot_holds_only_prov.description: If the snapshot took a blob the manifest does not prove or added private history, the export would publish bytes nobody reviewed.

pipeline.public_worker_timeout_diagnosti.description: A public worker crash prints its matching active timeout event while a crash without a timeout stays distinct.

pipeline.readmes_name_project_release.description: Both public READMEs name the project version as their current release in the heading, current-release sentence, notes link and last-checked line.
pipeline.readmes_name_project_release.lower_layer: The check reads the tracked project and both README files together.

pipeline.receipt_classes_every_red.description: Each red node and non-passing stage row classes as a defect, flake, slow test, load or tooling from its own evidence, and a red with no evidence reads unclassified, never a defect.

pipeline.receipt_plugin_writes_each_node.description: The receipt plugin writes each test node once, after its last phase or a crash, with its failure's masked signature, and then disposes of itself.

pipeline.receipt_verifies_only_complete_.description: A stage receipt verifies only when every announced event arrived and it meets the requested stage, host, head, result and optional passing test and time-limit checks.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

pipeline.result_cache_hits_only_on_uncha.description: A result-cache entry hits only while every file, listing, probe and variable value its group read is unchanged, and its declared key is the same.
pipeline.result_cache_hits_only_on_uncha.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_never_trusts_a_bad.description: A result-cache entry that is damaged, of another schema or key, or names a path outside its checkout is a miss, and a store or tree that cannot be used turns the cache off by its reason.
pipeline.result_cache_never_trusts_a_bad.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_refuses_undeclared.description: A recorder observes collection and execution inputs, storing only complete first-attempt passing results and declining opaque readers or bound native predicates without changing test outcomes.
pipeline.result_cache_refuses_undeclared.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_runner_serves_veri.description: The runner reuses only verified passing groups, records cache provenance, and runs misses or shadow comparisons without hiding changed or opaque inputs.
pipeline.result_cache_runner_serves_veri.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_store_stays_within.description: The result-cache store drops entries idle past 14 days and then the oldest while it holds more bytes than its cap.
pipeline.result_cache_store_stays_within.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.shipped_instruction_links_reach.description: If a shipped instruction linked outside the checkout, an installed agent would follow a dead path during its first use.

pipeline.slow_guards_run_when_the_change.description: A slow whole-tree guard runs in the commit stage when its own selection row says the change touches what it reads, and a change touching none of it runs none.
pipeline.slow_guards_run_when_the_change.lower_layer: The selection reads the real registry's rows and parses each changed file's text on both sides, which a unit fixture of rows alone cannot hold.

pipeline.stage_runs_each_row_by_one_prov.description: A stage run resolves each row on its host to exactly one provider, refusing a row with none or two, and writes a receipt that verifies.

pipeline.stage_target_is_separate_from_s.description: A stage enforces its declared stop while recording wall time, the reported rows and any unexplained time from which its target breach and timing gap can be derived.

pipeline.static_refusals_are_named_in_on.description: The fast guard runs every independent static check to its end, side by side in their own processes, and names each refusal and each unrunnable check in one attempt, before any slow step.
pipeline.static_refusals_are_named_in_on.lower_layer: The guard's main sequences its checks in one process over a tree, and no unit test of one check can show that all of them run to their ends.

pipeline.the_hook_keeps_its_bytecode_out.description: If the hook obeyed a caller's ban on bytecode, every check would compile the product's modules again on every commit; if it wrote bytecode into the checkout, the tree would carry caches.
pipeline.the_hook_keeps_its_bytecode_out.lower_layer: The hook's runner imports pre-commit and the process helpers it launches the hooks with, which no unit test may load; its environment is set where it runs.

pipeline.the_hook_leaves_whole_tree_chec.description: If the hook ran the checks that read the whole tree, each commit would wait half a minute; the commit stage runs them, and strict typing runs when its inputs are staged.
pipeline.the_hook_leaves_whole_tree_chec.retired: 2026-11-15: the hook runs every check that judges a change, side by side; pipeline.the_hook_runs_every_check_that_judges_a_change proves it.

pipeline.the_hook_runs_every_check_that_.description: If the hook left a check that judges a change to the commit stage, its red would cost a whole stage instead of seconds; strict typing runs when its inputs are staged.

pipeline.the_whole_public_tree_closes_at.description: If the release tree stopped closing over its manifest, the export would publish a file whose dependency users cannot get, with the gate silent.

portfolio_strategy_lab.advancement_refus.description: An advancement receipt index for one program cannot name another program.

portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_ledg.description: If finalization repeated a step, closed a permit twice or released another package's receipt, a protected result could publish without its own ledger.

portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_requ.description: A finalization cannot reopen a candidate that was never committed in its own ledger.
portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_requ.lower_layer: The finalization store's real dependencies include Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

portfolio_strategy_lab.ledger_index_tell.description: If a persisted ledger index could not tell a lost child from a bad index, recovery would rerun tampered work or refuse honest loss.

portfolio_strategy_lab.listing_axis_orde.description: If reordered listings hashed the same, two different portfolio paths would share one identity and advancement could reuse the wrong one.

product_host.held_data_update_names_prov.description: A plan using held market data says that no provider work is needed.
product_host.held_data_update_names_prov.lower_layer: The maintenance owner imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

product_host.host_stop_keeps_finishing_v.description: A stopping Host retains its lease and read-only status while its active work finishes and leaves queued work for resumption.

shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_at_its_bound.description: If a wait could run without a finite deadline, a hung check or a lost event would hold its caller for good.
shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_at_its_bound.retired: 2026-11-14: shared_kernel.waiting folded into shared_kernel.waits, one way to wait; shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_by_its_deadline_or_its_stop proves the same bound.

shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_by_its_deadlin.description: A wait returns its check's first result, or ends by name at its deadline or its stop event, and refuses an unbounded deadline.

shared_kernel.schema_hash_ignores_prose_.description: If a schema hash followed docstrings or missed a structural change, a rewording would rotate every identity or a real change would keep one.

task_control.a_lost_ledger_rebuilds_only.description: If recovery rebuilt the Task ledger from anything but frozen requests and orphan facts, a writer could invent, drop or repeat admitted Tasks.

task_control.a_worker_ends_with_its_pare.description: If a kept worker watched its parent by polling, or not at all, a Host that died would leave workers running or end them late.

task_control.dead_worker_reads_failed.description: A Task whose command raised and whose failure write died with it stops reading RUNNING at the Supervisor's next pass.

task_control.frozen_requests_refuse_cont.description: A frozen Task request must not be recovered from a file whose name does not bind its admitted content.

task_control.host_stop_preserves_recover.description: A Host stop finishes the current safe work, retains verified stages and resumes the same Task without treating the stop as a failed attempt.

testing.a_merge_is_budgeted_against_the_.description: The commit hook measures a merge's test budget against the tip its committer names in ALPHALATTICE_TEST_BUDGET_BASE, so a merge onto a tip ahead of develop is not charged with the changes beneath it; unset, the base is develop.

testing.an_os_only_test_names_its_os.description: If a test a change writes reached a Windows-only API without naming its OS, it would fail on the macOS and Ubuntu runners; the commit refuses it with the repair.

testing.antipattern_rules_hold_the_produ.description: The nightly refuses new source anti-patterns and checks that every slow rule catches its planted case.
testing.antipattern_rules_hold_the_produ.lower_layer: The rules run as an external process against the tracked product tree and cannot be proved by a unit mock.

testing.codspeed_marks_every_selected_te.description: Under CodSpeed, which deselects unmarked tests, every selected test is marked as a benchmark so the public cost job measures each one; a run without CodSpeed marks none.
testing.codspeed_marks_every_selected_te.retired: 2026-11-14: CodSpeed was retired from the product (the person's decision); its cost job and checks were deleted with it.

testing.codspeed_slice_names_a_repeat_un.description: The cost job's pilot-slice check calls each test body twice over its fixtures, as CodSpeed does, and names a body that passes once and fails again, with its repair.
testing.codspeed_slice_names_a_repeat_un.lower_layer: The proof runs the workflow step's own code as a child pytest process over a planted slice, which a unit test cannot start.
testing.codspeed_slice_names_a_repeat_un.retired: 2026-11-14: CodSpeed was retired from the product (the person's decision); its cost job and checks were deleted with it.

testing.crash_requeue_keeps_longest_firs.description: Under load distribution, a crashed worker's prefetched cases return to their place in the longest-first collection order, never after every other case.

testing.fast_whole_tree_guard_runs_when_.description: A deferred whole-tree guard runs in the commit stage when the tree it declares it reads changed; one recorded as slow still waits for post-merge, and without the rule nothing moves.

testing.find_matches_requirements_and_un.description: One search returns the registered requirements and the unregistered tests whose words match, best first, with each requirement's lifecycle and holders.

testing.integration_share_only_falls.description: A change that raises an area's integration share of test functions is refused by name, and a row added above unit says why a lower layer cannot prove it.

testing.layer_contract.description: Registered unit layers obey resource and own-phase time boundaries, while integration layers retain their declared database and file access.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

testing.lint_rules_improve_the_code.description: Lint refuses a print outside the command layer and a public definition with no docstring, and accepts a bound lambda and a docstring's form.
testing.lint_rules_improve_the_code.lower_layer: The verdicts come from Ruff run as an external process with the product's own configuration and its per-path scopes, which a unit mock cannot prove.

exception.why: The source fell because a 141-line docstring checker became Ruff configuration, which the source count does not see; the goal asks one holder case per changed rule
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: the maintainer: one table-driven case holds the three rule verdicts

testing.narrow_fixture_scratch_goes_with.description: A fixture narrower than the session removes the temporary roots it made once its own teardown is done, unless a test failed while it lived; a session fixture keeps its roots to the session's end.

testing.observed_test_resources.description: Each completed test records its own phase durations and observed resources, including subprocess counts and explicit unknowns, without changing its result.

testing.one_holder_per_layer.description: A requirement has one holder file in each layer, while focused functions and parameter cases in that file preserve its place.

testing.only_a_requirement_marker_may_jo.description: If a requirement marker counted as file growth or a test change, tracing a critical test would be refused or push a Large test off its merge path.

testing.reuse_pin_fast_check.description: The fast lane runs the reviewed reuse frontier check on changed pinned source files and names how to refresh a moved pin.

testing.row_admitted_or_refused_by_its_c.description: A new or edited requirement row is admitted at once when its id, owner, sentence, layer and budget pass without a near-duplicate, and is otherwise refused by its failing check or held for the test manager's decision.

testing.session_footprint.description: A verified full pytest run records session-fixture build time and attributed scratch with a sampled basetemp high-water mark and explicit gaps.

testing.size_counts_are_review_signals.description: A size or form count over its bound (C901, PLR0912, PLR0915, more than four mocks) never refuses a commit and is named as a signal in a function the change wrote; a blanket type ignore still refuses.
testing.size_counts_are_review_signals.lower_layer: The counts come from Ruff run as an external process over the change's text, which a unit mock cannot prove.

testing.test_budgets_only_fall.description: A raised or added test budget is refused at commit unless a budget admission carries a dated decision and a value at or above it.

testing.test_placement_and_structural_sc.description: New test files must declare their owner and source, and a deferred structural test must have a valid scope before selection.
testing.test_placement_and_structural_sc.lower_layer: The selection checks read and construct registered policy files, which a unit test cannot access.

testing.tests_grow_no_faster_than_source.description: A change whose net test lines outgrow its net source past the policy's floor is refused by name, unless each new test's requirement carries the test manager's decided growth exception.

exception.why: The rule's own test gains the planted case of a rewrite that adds no test function
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: fix the rule with one planted case in the existing growth test

testing.the_semgrep_scan_gets_a_short_te.description: If semgrep ran under a stage's long TEMP on Windows, semgrep-core would fail on the path limit and the source rules would refuse every change unmeasured.

testing.the_stage_judges_the_committed_c.description: If the commit stage judged only the working tree, a committed test-shape break the hook refuses at the index would pass the stage, or an inherited one would refuse it.
testing.the_stage_judges_the_committed_c.lower_layer: The check chooses its snapshot through Git processes, the merge base and the head or index blobs, and the unit layer may not depend on subprocess.

testing.unplaced_workers_warn_by_name.description: Inside the private workshop, an unplaced pytest run asking for more than two workers is warned once with heavy_slot's command, never refused; other runs stay silent.

testing.unregistered_test_refused_with_i.description: A new test that proves no registered requirement is refused by the fast guard with what tests find returns for its words and the next lawful step, and in a gate lane beyond its file's legacy count.

testing.whole_file_relocation_restores_b.description: Whole-file test relocation restores bytes and registered references, preserves consumed fixture scope and refuses path, export and fixture-name clashes.
testing.whole_file_relocation_restores_b.retired: 2026-11-08: the completed one-time test mover was retired; placement and structural scope checks stay.

testing.windows_worker_without_wmi.description: A Windows pytest worker obtains platform information without issuing a WMI query.

testing.worker_collection_refusal_is_nam.description: An xdist worker that refuses its collection names itself and the refusal in the run's log before it ends, so a stage never reports only a crash on a test that never ran.

testing.worker_crash_evidence_is_named.description: A dead pytest worker records its actual exit, running test and fault output, and missing evidence remains unknown.

workspace_runtime.a_kept_value_follows_i.description: If a value kept for a sealed file answered after that file was gone or replaced at its path, a replay would prove an artifact the workspace no longer holds.
workspace_runtime.a_kept_value_follows_i.lower_layer: It removes and rewrites a real sealed file behind the store's process memory, which only the file system holds.

exception.why: The memo's 20 existing tests state both file-system rules (kept, and not kept where no lifetime handle exists) instead of skipping there, as the review required
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: Lead: the excess is the coverage of the second file-system rule; keep every check

workspace_runtime.background_task_gate_w.description: A background Task waits for a workspace mutation holder, names the holder and preserves its deferred cancellation without duplicating execution.

workspace_runtime.changed_file_ends_its_.description: If a file's kept digest survived a change to its bytes, a later read would trust content it never hashed.
workspace_runtime.changed_file_ends_its_.lower_layer: The fact journal is keyed by the file's bytes and stamps on disk, which only a filesystem test can change.

workspace_runtime.full_proof_refuses_a_c.description: If full proof trusted a sealed file's name or stamps, an export or the scrub would pass bytes changed under that name.
workspace_runtime.full_proof_refuses_a_c.lower_layer: The change is planted in a real file under its sealed name with its stamps restored, which only a filesystem test can do.

workspace_runtime.host_stop_reaches_para.description: A Host stop reaches each concurrent work-item thread and leaves the admitted Task recoverable after its workers return.

workspace_runtime.installed_extensions_o.description: Every workspace handle refuses SQL and method forms of runtime extension installation before the engine can read a repository.
workspace_runtime.installed_extensions_o.lower_layer: The native DuckDB statement parser and registration APIs define this boundary; an in-memory policy double cannot prove that SQL and method calls reach it.

workspace_runtime.parallel_source_checks.description: If parallel source checks shared contexts, ran unbounded or lost a failure, a check could leak another's memory, starve the process or pass a refusal.
workspace_runtime.parallel_source_checks.lower_layer: It drives the shared check pool from several threads at once, which a unit test of one callback cannot exercise.

workspace_runtime.seal_record_survives_a.description: A file another process holds neither stops a store's open while the hold is brief nor kills a worker at its close.

workspace_runtime.sealed_read_leaves_not.description: If reading sealed bytes left a watching thread or an open handle, the Host would spend CPU on every read and a file could not be renamed or removed.
workspace_runtime.sealed_read_leaves_not.lower_layer: Open handles and live threads are process facts a unit test cannot observe without the real store and filesystem.

workspace_runtime.sealed_reads_share_one.description: If concurrent readers of one sealed source each built it, or a failed build were kept, the Host would repeat the work or answer from a refusal.
workspace_runtime.sealed_reads_share_one.lower_layer: It runs real threads against the process memory's single producer, which a unit test of one call cannot interleave.

workspace_runtime.sealed_value_built_onc.description: If a value built from sealed sources were built again on every read, each read would pay a proof the Host's only-writer rule already settled; full proof must still build it from the bytes.
workspace_runtime.sealed_value_built_onc.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the store's process memory across request scopes, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

workspace_runtime.source_lease_failure_e.description: A failed sealed-source mutation check names the written and observed bytes, restored and observed metadata, and the unavailable lease event.
workspace_runtime.source_lease_failure_e.retired: 2026-11-15: read leases retired; a sealed file is proved at its edges (LAWS.md EV2)

workspace_runtime.source_owner_keeps_one.description: If an owner's complete value kept a second copy of its nested bytes, or kept a mutable result, memory would double or one caller could change another's read.
workspace_runtime.source_owner_keeps_one.lower_layer: It counts decodes and reads across nested owners on real files through the process memory, beyond one function's reach.
